events.body:
**Paused: this is a reminder only.** Nothing needs to change until someone decides.

The stale branch [`blt-action/disable-assign-command`](https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/tree/blt-action/disable-assign-command) turned off the `/assign` command in BLT-Action ([`blt-action`](https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/tree/main/blt-action)). That change would apply to every repository that uses the action, so it was not merged during the branch cleanup.

## Question to settle

If both BLT-Pool ([`blt-pool`](https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/tree/main/blt-pool)) and BLT-Action respond to `/assign` in BLT repositories, contributors get two answers (or two assignments). Pick one of them to handle `/assign` in BLT repositories, and turn the command off in the other through the workflow configuration for those repositories, not globally in the action, so other projects using BLT-Action keep `/assign`.

- [ ] Confirm whether both bots actually respond to `/assign` in BLT repositories
- [ ] Decide which one owns `/assign`
- [ ] Disable `/assign` in the other through its per-repository configuration
- [ ] Delete the [`blt-action/disable-assign-command`](https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/tree/blt-action/disable-assign-command) branch once this is settled
events.title: blt-action: decide who answers /assign (BLT-Action vs BLT-Pool)
